subject: @abh/core bounded Tracked and recorded object artifact cleanup with explicit tracking resolution
coverage: data.object_staging_attempts is tenant-isolated, manifest-registered and least-privileged
ObjectStorePort.put Tracked results persist the returned Artifact tracking ref without inventing a StoredObjectRef
Completed put descriptors are checked against staged digest, size and media type before persistence
Completed puts that later fail readback or publication persist a Recorded object ref and remain cleanable
the host resolver must explicitly declare the StoredObjectRef before cleanup
resolved object refs become Ready and are scanned only after the configured minimum age
cleanup queueing persists a stable deletion proof id and idempotency key
current abh.artifacts.delete authorization is checked against the resolved StoredObjectRef
work leases and fencing tokens protect tracking resolution and physical deletion
delete completion must return the exact StoredObjectRef before the database advances
T2 atomically tombstones the Staged Artifact and records CleanupCompleted
unresolved Tracked metadata remains preserved rather than being guessed or deleted
runtime hosting snapshots cleanup configuration before loop startup
limits: production cloud or remote tracking resolution and ObjectStore adapters remain host-installed
Pending staging attempts that never received a tracking ref are not physically addressable
a process crash between an adapter returning Completed and Core recording its response remains unavoidable without a portable two-phase port
binary media staging remains out of scope for the Tool JSON path
